descriptionHtml:
Onikuma X25 RGB Gaming Headset with 50mm Driver - White Edition

Transform your soundscape aesthetics and achieve total immersion with the stunning Onikuma X25 RGB Gaming Headset in Pure White. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium PC hardware audio peripheral is masterfully engineered for competitive esports players, dynamic live stream operators, and active digital website managers across Egypt who demand high-fidelity sound precision, crystal-clear voice clarity, and elite comfort. Boasting an ultra-sleek white profile that flawlessly complements custom white custom desktop setups, this headset is backed by an official 1-year warranty for absolute peace of mind.

The Onikuma X25 White is driven by massive high-grade 50mm speaker units designed to generate a highly detailed, wide soundstage framework with booming low-end bass and crisp high frequencies. It features a fully flexible 360-degree omnidirectional noise-canceling microphone line that isolates your voice from distracting room ambiance. For unmatched endurance during long-hour raids, the oversized earcups and adaptive headband layout are layered with soft, breathable memory foam materials. Finished with striking multi-zone dynamic RGB backlight illumination radiating through its white chassis line, this headset offers easy plug-and-play 3.5mm connectivity for multi-platform support across PC, consoles, and mobile systems.
